items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: We were the only ones who'd made a picture with Gene Autry, old Susanna.

ctx.x: Now you tell me what, now it's time, you tell me what others, compare the, if you would, do you recall the records made in the thirties and all with these other bands? Oh, no. No. We were the only ones who'd made a picture with Gene Autry, old Susanna. Did you know about that? No.
I really, I feel painfully ignorant of certain of the things that were happening in Western Swing. And, uh, uh, that's why a lot of things are lacking, you know, in this, but that's why
